mission.title: Rising Tensions
mission.description: Help Zion's operatives find out where Veil has gone.

npc.say: Turns out Veil was talking with her people the whole time she was in her cell. Those are all the communications we managed to intercept. Maybe you can make something out of it.
We were able to work together to defeat the Assassin... I think we can work together again now!
Give the data to Zalenski, human.
I find my work quite fulfilling. Do you?
I believe your presence is required elsewhere.
Please return to Gouki for analysis results, {player}.

{player}, it would appear that this data reveals some time sensitive information. The human known as Veil will be using a communications nexus to reach some associates. According to this data, she may already be at the location.

phase.briefing:
{player}. Your services are required once more. We have a most... unusual request for a meeting.
Some Zion operatives appear to be in need of our assistance. Since the business with the Assassin, we have been on good terms with them. It is your responsibility to maintain friendly relations. Proceed to the location indicated and assist them.

enter.say: All right, your contact's name is Bilkis. She'll be able to fill you in on this whole business.

talk.say: Well, I never. Working with the toasters...
I'm sure you know about it by now... Veil is gone. We have to get her back.
Bilkis! Remember, we've got orders... we can't let her get away with this!
She's gone, huh... sounds like those masked bastards made good on their plans. Better get that CD from Bilkis so we can see what it is.
Damn it! I know we have orders... here, take this disk. We... we need you to run this data through the Machines' systems. Maybe you'll be able to find something we can't.

done.say: Okay, so we need to run all these communications through the Machine server, huh? I'll get the clearances lined up.
Turns out Veil was talking with her people the whole time she was in her cell. Those are all the communications we managed to intercept. Maybe you can make something out of it.

phase.briefing: Clearance has been processed. Proceed to the analysis center and give the data to Zalenski.

done.say: Now the data must be processed. Please speak with Agent Clark on your way out.

talk.say:
{player}, some related data must be relayed. The following chain of data was retrieved earlier today, perhaps related to your investigations: B200U205C210K215--
One moment please...
Please report back to Gouki.
Apparently there is an urgent matter involving the data analysis.

{player}, it would appear that this data reveals some time sensitive information. The human known as Veil will be using a communications nexus to reach some associates. According to this data, she may already be at the location.

done.say: You've got to get out of here now and get over to that location before she's gone again, {player}!

phase.briefing: Proceed with all speed to the indicated location, {player}. You will be assisted on this mission by the crew of the Nescire, a Zion hovercraft. They may arrive before you; please maintain control over firearms at all times to avoid unnecessary casualties.

enter.say: I think the Zion crew is here already. Help them and don't let Veil out of there!

complete.say: Well, looks like we all missed her... I guess those Zion ops are going to make sure they get all the evidence...?

mission.finish: How unfortunate that you were not able to apprehend our fugitive, {player}. Let us hope that you shall have another chance in the future.
